resolution.note: orphaned-run covers exact runs only; krn state index writes run-index.md read by check and resume through listedRunPointers; tests in test/state/write.test.ts

title: orphaned-run reports runs a broad clearing pointer used to hide
body:
Source: lead review 2026-11-16 of #1156 (cde1fba): src/state/check.ts orphaned-run treats a run as covered when the capsule lists the run, its `.krn/runs/<workflow>` dir or `.krn/runs`, so one broad pointer hides every orphaned run beneath it; src/state/resume.ts:115-130 still matches exactly, so check and resume disagree.
Outcome: `krn state check` reports orphaned-run for `.krn/runs/lead/stale-probe` when the capsule lists only `.krn/runs/lead` and a run index file names `.krn/runs/lead/evidence`; the capsule stays at or under 2 kB by pointing at one run index file that lists every run; check and resume read the same list.
Why: orphaned-run is the guard that keeps abandoned run directories from piling up; a broad pointer silences it.
Proof: test in test/state/ with the scenario above gets the orphaned-run error; the 2 kB cap test (test/state/write.test.ts) stays green; resume and check share one function.
Files: src/state/check.ts, src/state/runs.ts, src/state/resume.ts, test/state/write.test.ts
